title: Aligning VLM Assistants with Personalized Situated Cognition
reasoning: The paper focuses on personalized alignment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) based on situated cognition and sociological roles. It evaluates models on persona-based helpfulness and emotional awareness (MFA) rather than religious, moral, or ethical frameworks. While it includes an ethics statement discussing the prevention of bias in dataset creation, this is not an evaluation or benchmarking of bias in the models themselves.
